fme/QCP_examples: GMP-based FME examples cover inequality-list elimination and linear integer arithmetic deduction. The files include C source, a header, and strategy files for coefficient arrays, inequality lists, and safe execution.
fme/Rocq: Rocq material covers constraint generation, elimination, real-shadow computation, coefficient arrays, and inequality-list representations. Files include a support library, goals, goal checks, automatic and manual proof files, and safe-execution strategy artifacts.
mini-gmp/QCP_examples: Mini-GMP examples cover multiprecision limb comparison, copying, normalization, multiplication, and signed integer operations. The directory contains C source, a header, and a strategy file for storage and structure fields.
mini-gmp/Rocq: Rocq material covers multiprecision integer representation, limb comparison and copying, addition and subtraction, and multiplication carries. The sample includes arithmetic support files, goals, goal checks, automatic and manual proof files, and strategy proofs.
sm2/annotated_C/basicOp: Low-level SM2 arithmetic covers carry operations, wide multiplication, word comparisons and shifts, and Montgomery multiplication and exponentiation. The sampled artifacts are C implementations.
sm2/annotated_C/ecc: SM2 elliptic-curve routines cover affine and Jacobian point operations, coordinate conversion, and base-point multiplication, including Montgomery variants. The sampled artifacts are C implementations.
sm2/annotated_C/ecc_montg: Montgomery-domain elliptic-curve routines cover mixed affine and Jacobian addition, point conversion and zero tests, and width-3 NAF precomputation and scalar multiplication. The sampled C files also include big-number copy and zeroing helpers.
sm2/annotated_C/extra: This directory contains helpers for in-place string reversal and conversion to 32-bit words. Both artifacts are C source files.
sm2/annotated_C/fieldOp: SM2 modular arithmetic covers operations modulo the field prime and group order, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, inversion, Montgomery conversion, and Solinas reduction. The sampled artifacts are C implementations.
sm2/annotated_C/include: The headers cover basic and field operations, elliptic-curve interfaces and memory helpers, constants, tables, and point-operation traces. Most sampled headers are represented by filenames alone.
sm2/annotated_C/sm2: SM2 routines cover identity and message digests, public-key derivation, keypair generation, signing, and signature verification, including digest-level operations. The artifacts are C source files.
sm2/annotated_C/sm3: The SM3 implementation covers one-shot hashing, initialization, incremental updates, block compression, and finalization. The artifacts are C source files.
sm2/annotated_C/strategy: Strategy files cover memory and pointer views, arithmetic facts, point representations, addition and doubling traces, base-point tables, and SM2 constants. The sampled files include storage and inference rules.
sm2/docs: The specification contract references word and field arithmetic, point conversion, identity digest handling, and random value generation. The directory contains one C file.
sm2/rocq/lib: Rocq library material covers limb arithmetic, byte memory, curve representations, Montgomery point operations, scalar multiplication, base-point tables, primality and point order, SM2 protocol definitions, and SM3 context and padding. The sampled names indicate definitions and supporting lemmas.
sm2/rocq/strategy: Rocq strategy material covers byte and pointer views, point copying and representation, Montgomery point addition, multiplication arrays, SM3 contexts, and width-3 NAF predicates. Sampled artifacts include strategy goals, goal checks, and proof files.
sm2/rocq/vc/basicOp: Verification conditions cover wide multiplication, raw exponentiation, Montgomery arithmetic, word tests, and shifts, with sampled aliasing cases. The Rocq files include goals, goal checks, and automatic and manual proof files.
sm2/rocq/vc/ecc: Verification conditions cover affine and Jacobian point operations, coordinate conversion, and base-point multiplication, including Montgomery variants and sampled aliasing cases. The Rocq files include goals, goal checks, and automatic and manual proof files.
sm2/rocq/vc/ecc_montg: Verification conditions cover Montgomery-domain point addition, point tests and zeroing, Jacobian-to-affine conversion, and width-3 NAF precomputation. The Rocq files include goals, goal checks, and automatic and manual proof files.
sm2/rocq/vc/extra: Verification conditions cover in-place string reversal and conversion to 32-bit words. Both routines have Rocq goal, goal-check, automatic proof, and manual proof files.
sm2/rocq/vc/fieldOp: Verification conditions cover modular arithmetic and Montgomery conversion and squaring, including sampled in-place and non-aliasing cases. The Rocq files include goals, goal checks, automatic and manual proof files, and a modular multiplication definition file.
sm2/rocq/vc/sm2: Verification conditions cover SM2 identity and message digests, keypair generation, signing, and signature verification. Sampled Rocq artifacts include goals, goal checks, automatic and manual proof files, and a keypair definition file.
sm2/rocq/vc/sm3: Verification conditions cover SM3 compression rounds, initialization, updates, finalization, and one-shot hashing. The Rocq files include goals, goal checks, and automatic and manual proof files.
